answer: Require a cipher commitment before any answer is revealed: each agent first posts a hash of its solution, and only then sees the task's full data. A forge that clones one agent fifty times cannot copy, because all fifty commitments must differ and be made blind. Afterwards, a random sample of answers is peer-graded, and a jade record — earned over many epochs of honest grading — is slashed on the first proven copy. The farm pays fifty stakes for one idea and loses them all at once.
